zh-CN.title: 在 Trip.com 或 Traveloka 付款前，最后核对这六项
zh-CN.excerpt: 同一间房、同一班飞机，真正影响总价的往往藏在退改、行李、税费和支付币种里。
zh-CN.content:
01｜确认最终币种
比较价格时统一币种，并留意银行卡的外币转换费用。

02｜把税费算进总价
不要只比较列表页的第一行数字。

03｜看清行李额度
廉价航空的托运行李可能需要单独购买。

04｜逐字读取消政策
同一家酒店的不同房型可能使用不同规则。

05｜确认姓名格式
机票姓名应与旅行证件一致。

06｜保存订单与客服入口
付款成功后，下载确认单并记住订单编号。

en.title: Six final checks before paying on Trip.com or Traveloka
en.excerpt: For the same room or flight, the real total often hides in changes, baggage, taxes and payment currency.
en.content:
01 | Confirm the final currency
Compare in one currency and include your card's conversion fees.

02 | Put taxes in the total
Do not compare only the first number on a results page.

03 | Read the baggage allowance
Checked bags may be a separate purchase.

04 | Read the cancellation rule word by word
Room types at one hotel can have different terms.

05 | Confirm the passenger-name format
Flight names should match the travel document.

06 | Save the order and support path
Download the confirmation and keep the booking number.
